body:
OWNER REPORT, 15 Nov 2026 (relayed from chat), reopens the ranking of a typed half name: "searching landmrvk instead of landmrvks shows one of their songs instead of the band, fix this."
REPRODUCED on the A35 (build 156, the search typed into the field, no autocorrect): "landmvrk" (the band LANDMVRKS without its last letter) and "landmvr" give "Top result: Song, LANDMVRKS - CONCERT 4K - ZENITH DE PARIS 2026 - slash musique" and the band is NOT the Top result. "landmrvks" (a swap) gives "Top result: Artist, LANDMVRKS, 60K fans" (N-23a works) and "landmrvk" lists the band first under Artists but with no Top result card.
CAUSE (read in search_rank.dart / search_assembly.dart): the song is a library row from an old import, saved with its uploader as its artist ("slash musique", before N-26) and a title that begins with the band's name. songMatch gives a title that STARTS with the typed words 0.5 + 0.13 (starts) + 0.09 (covers the title's words) + a little = about 0.72; artistMatch gives the start of an artist's name 0.7. So a song that merely repeats the band's name in its title beats the band whose name was typed unfinished. Not a Deezer row: it is the library's.
PLAN (advisor, 15 Nov): do NOT raise the artist-start score (the scale of P1-07 stays: 'love' must not give Lovejoy as the Top result). Instead, in songMatch, a title with a leading 'Words - ' segment (the usual 'Artist - Title' of an upload) has that segment scored as ARTIST words, not as title words, so the upload scores about 0.53, under the artist's 0.7. Tests first: 'landmvrk' gives the artist as the Top result; 'jinj' gives Jinjer; the 20 recorded searches unchanged; a title with a dash that is really the song ('Hotel California - Live') is not hurt. The data fix (the row's artist is the channel) is N-26 slice 5 (repair of stored rows, trigger-gated) and N-34 (the album): the ranking rule is the second layer and stays correct after them. The phone has no 'Artist - Title' splitter today (the server's is imports/uploads.py); a second one in Dart is the cost, with the removal trigger: N-26 slice 5 has refiled the stored rows.
